item.title: Introducing the commission on research for better economic growth
item.description: James Coe and Sarah Chaytor launch the brand new commission on research for better economic growth

item.title: The student group claim settles out of court
item.description: An out of court settlement brings legal action at UCL over pandemic and strike disruption to a close. Jim Dickinson explores why questions about variation, acts of god and liability remain unanswered.

item.title: The new TEF must not take a one-size-fits-all approach to specialist institutions
item.description: Bringing specialist and postgraduate-only providers into a revised Teaching Excellence Framework carries significant risks. Royal College of Art vice chancellor Christoph Lindner explains

item.title: As a head of institution I need people to tell me when they think I’m wrong
item.description: Keele University vice chancellor Kevin Shakesheff launches the Keele Debates, in the hopes of fostering constructive disagreement over complex HE challenges

item.title: Who calls the shots when resolving students’ complaints?

item.title: What happens when inclusion loses its limits?
item.description: Evie Papavasiliou and Angelos Bakogiannis argue that HE’s ever-expanding definition of inclusion has drifted into an unmanageable institutional obligation that risks flattening the demands of learning itself

item.title: What needs to change to make evidence-based teaching the norm?
item.description: How can we expect high-quality teaching if we don't fund the research that makes it possible? Nic Labrosse and Alison Voice make the case for evidence-informed teaching

item.title: Why are universities missing from the duty of candour?
item.description: The Hillsborough Law promises institutional candour, but Emma Roberts warns that universities have been left in a grey area that could take litigation to resolve

item.description: As the annual HESA Staff open data is published, Farheen Akhtar reflects on the upcoming changes to the data reporting and its broader benefits for UK skills planning

item.title: How universities can rise to the challenge of an unpredictable future workplace
item.description: As UUK launches Future Universities, Nishan Canagarajah highlights the power – and responsibility – of universities to enhance student employment
